record.question: How many years does India grant a product patent for a new pharmaceutical drug, under the Indian Patent Act 1970 (2005 amendment)?
options: 7 years from the date of filling
10 years from the date of filling
20 years from the date of filling
30 years from the date of filling
record.explanation: Answer C: 20 years from the date of filling. Indian patent term is 20 years from the filing date under the Patents Act, 1970, including pharmaceutical product patents subject to patentability provisions. Reference: https://ipindia.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Images/pdf/Patents_Act_1970__Updated_till_23_June_2017_.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
